Comments: Civil and National Registration operated by Department under Ministry of Nationality. Civil registration services identified as target for SmartBots digitisation. SADC eKYC initiative (FinMark Trust/Co-Develop) aims for cross-border civil registration interoperability including Botswana.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Department of Civil and National Registration under Ministry of Nationality operates digital national ID system. SmartBots specifically identifies "timely and accurate registration and management of services" as key outcome. EU project includes improvement of core registries. Digital Services Authority will oversee digital ID infrastructure. No confirmed fully operational national digital ID linked to data exchange.

Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: Botswana National eHealth Strategy identifies need for establishing "standards and interoperability framework" - but as of research (2023) eRecord systems in Botswana are NOT interoperable within or between public/private sectors (JMIR 2023 study). mHealth interoperability framework (mHeRIF) under development. Health integration is a documented gap.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Data Protection Act 18 of 2024 (effective January 14, 2025) - replaces 2018 Act with stronger provisions. Digital Services Bill passed August 14, 2025. Cybersecurity Bill passed August 14, 2025. EU project supports legal framework for IOP standards. Enabling legislation exists and recently strengthened.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: SmartBots strategy provides directional roadmap but EU project assessment (2022) notes absence of structured implementation milestones. EU MIP 2021-2027 Action Document describes roadmap targets (IOP framework by 2023 target; core registry compliance by 2027). Digital Services Bill passed 2025. Implementation roadmap under active development, not fully published.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Botswana National Digital Transformation Strategy (SmartBots) adopted July 2020. EU/Expertise France project with ESTDEV (Estonian Centre for International Development) supporting development of National Interoperability Framework, core registries improvement and proof-of-concept solutions. GovOnline portal exists. Digital Services Bill passed August 14, 2025 establishing Digital Services Authority. Interoperability framework under active development - IOP standards, guidelines being established. No confirmed fully operational national data exchange layer.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: EU project includes establishing W3C WCAG AA web accessibility standards. Digital Competency Framework rollout underway. Mobile penetration exceeds population (4.43M subscriptions). EGDI 2022 score 0.5495 below global average with online service availability particularly low. Accessibility improvements in progress.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection Act 18 of 2024 requires data transfers outside Botswana to maintain a copy within Botswana and restricts transfers without adequate protection determination. Digital Services Bill (2025) establishes regulatory framework. Cybersecurity Bill (2025) passed. Strong statutory data sovereignty provisions though enforcement capacity still developing.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: SmartBots Village Connectivity Programme targets rural districts. Botswana Research and Education Network. 98.2% 4G coverage nationally (March 2024). EU project funds expansion to all districts. SmartBots Lab expanding to all districts. Government services currently largely national level; sub-national integration under development.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: 98.2% 4G coverage and 41.89% 5G coverage (March 2024) indicating broad connectivity. SmartBots Village Connectivity Programme specifically targets rural areas. 500 schools connected to internet. Satellite services (BOTSAT-1) enable rural connectivity. Partial rural coverage with active rural expansion programme.
